title: F5 fix round 1: resume argv must not carry -s/--sandbox either (review T-0251 request_changes on T-0249)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 68b8ba0 "Fix Codex resume argv handling" (T-0249) in git log; if not, run git checkout -B task/T-0254 task/T-0249. Never drop that commit.
Review T-0251 (high): orchestrator/executor.py argv_for("resume", ...) still appends the access list, and when pool.toml [codex] dangerous_full_access is false that list is ['-s', 'workspace-write'], which `codex exec resume` rejects the same way it rejected -C (verified on this machine: error: unexpected argument '-s' found). It only works today because dangerous_full_access is true. The docstring's observed option list for resume has --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox and --config but no -s/--sandbox.
Change executor.py:
1. argv_for("resume"): translate the access list: keep --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox as is; replace ['-s', '<mode>'] with ['--config', 'sandbox_mode="<mode>"'] (resume accepts --config); never emit -s or --sandbox on resume. Fresh exec argv stays byte-identical.
2. When _run returns the 'codex argv error:' failure (rc 2 usage error), also bus.log_run the attempt with outcome failed and the reason, and bus.update the task with resume_hint {'argv_error': reason[:300]} so the failure is visible on the bus, still without consuming a round.
Tests in tests/test_executor.py: test_resume_argv_translates_sandbox_to_config (access ['-s','workspace-write'] yields --config sandbox_mode="workspace-write" and no -s), test_resume_argv_keeps_bypass_flag, test_argv_error_logs_run_and_hint. Keep the three T-0249 tests green.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 68b8ba0 below your commit
tests/test_executor.py::test_resume_argv_translates_sandbox_to_config, ::test_resume_argv_keeps_bypass_flag, ::test_argv_error_logs_run_and_hint pass and the T-0249 tests still pass
argv_for('resume', ...) output contains neither '-s' nor '--sandbox' for either access mode, and argv_for('exec', ...) is unchanged
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
